snippet.title: How I made Breaking Bad for the Nintendo DS
snippet.description:
I walk through how I wrote breaking bad for the nintendo ds! you can play it on your own system if you want!

DOWNLOAD: https://william278.net/project/breaking-bad-ds (use melonDS/a flashcart/a modded DSi)
SOURCE CODE: https://github.com/WiIIiam278/breaking-bad-ds
SAUL GOODMAN: https://youtu.be/io08u1cYmsM

*videos used!*
- Super Mario 64 | Nintendo 64 VS Nintendo DS HD GRAPHICS COMPARISON by @ElAnalistaDeBits (https://youtu.be/ZdDyYfr7raA)
- How Graphics worked on the Nintendo DS by @ModernVintageGamer (https://youtu.be/kBgQJJ93nFM)
(I sent an email to both for permission but didn't hear back after a few days! I hope it's okay to use your footage -- I love both these videos!!!)

*assets used in-game!*
https://github.com/WiIIiam278/breaking-bad-ds/blob/main/ATTRIBUTION.md

*music used!*
- Super Mario 64 DS - Casino
- The Legend of Zelda: Spirit Tracks - Final Exam
- McDonald's eCDP - Online Order
- Suzumiya Haruhi no Chokuretsu - The Fate of Hardship
- Kenken Ouen Recipe 1000 Kondate Zenshuu - Cook
- Wii U System Music - Download Management
- Suzumiya Haruhi no Chokuretsu - The Final Cleanup
- The Legend of Zelda: Spirit Tracks - Outset Village
- Another Code: R - A Journey into Lost Memories - Back in Time
- Breaking Bad - Title Theme (Extended)
- And Yet The Town Moves - Closing Times

*follow me!*
🌎 Website: https://william278.net/
✖️ Twitter/X: https://twitter.com/William27528
🟦 Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/william278.net
💻 GitHub: https://github.com/WiIIiam278
